info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Parking Reservations Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Parking Reservations API enables users to promptly cancel existing parking reservations. This operation is vital for managing reservation schedules and freeing up parking spaces efficiently. Common consumers of this API include mobile application users and web portal customers who wish to modify their booking arrangements. By streamlining the cancellation process, businesses can enhance the customer experience and optimize parking resource utilization.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing reservation. Provide the necessary details in the request to identify the reservation you wish to cancel. Ensure that you have the right permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing reservation. It should include the necessary identifiers or parameters to specify which reservation is to be canceled.

200.description: Cancellation request completed successfully, and the reservation has been removed.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a reservation operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the reservation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the reservation after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message or information regarding the cancellation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.description: Response schema for the cancellation of reservations.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details of the audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the server's processing time for the request.

schema.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
